Name: (AT) Soren's Botanical Wallpapers
Author: nordkyst
Description:
A pack of 32 wallpapers I made for my own current playthrough. Hopefully someone else will enjoy them too! :)

[b][u]How To Use[/u][/b]
Requires Alternative Textures. Apply with the Paint Bucket from Robin's Carpenter Shop.

[b][u]Permissions[/u][/b]
I'm probably not going to add more wood or flower colors, so if you want to recolor/edit these, go ham. Please [b]give credit [/b]on your page and [b]leave a comment [/b]so I can check it out! I'd love to see.

[b][u]Credits[/u][/b]
The neutral, cheerful color scheme was inspired by Orangeblossom's wonderful furniture mods, which I've been using for like 3 playthroughs in a row now. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23073]Please check their work out![/url]﻿ These walls won't match perfectly as I was guesstimating the colors, but they should go well enough together. :)
